display.purpose: Hero headline, logo mark, section titles. Wide geometric retail-sign voice.

body.purpose: Product copy, descriptions, form text. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: Prices, counts, stock, buttons, section links. Uppercase with wide tracking.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Lifted hover state — always paired with the spring lift.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Hover lift (translateY -6px, scale 1.02), price pop, FLIP reflow, nav underline morph.

motion.name: glow-low
motion.purpose: Flash module pulses when time runs low.

components.name: Primary Button (Electric Lime)
components.description: The one CTA voice — lime fill, ink text, mono bold label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#C6FF00; color:#0D0D0D; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.15em; padding:14px 24px; border-radius:8px; border:0; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgb(198 255 0 / 0.35); transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#D7FF47; transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0D0D0D; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Ink fill, lime text — secondary CTAs on light ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#0D0D0D; color:#C6FF00; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.15em; padding:12px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:0; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .3s; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgb(13 13 13 / .18); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C6FF00; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Bento Card
components.description: Ruled white tile with lime corner ticks — the board's registration mark.
components.css: .ds-card { position:relative; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid rgb(13 13 13 / .09); border-radius:16px; padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(13 13 13 / .04), 0 8px 24px rgb(13 13 13 / .07); transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), border-color .3s; } .ds-card::before, .ds-card::after { content:""; position:absolute; width:9px; height:9px; border:1.5px solid #C6FF00; } .ds-card::before { top:-1px; left:-1px; border-right:0; border-bottom:0; border-radius:16px 0 0 0; } .ds-card::after { bottom:-1px; right:-1px; border-left:0; border-top:0; border-radius:0 0 16px 0; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgb(13 13 13 / .06), 0 20px 44px rgb(13 13 13 / .14); border-color:rgb(166 200 0 / .5); } .ds-card strong { font-family:Inter,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:#0D0D0D; } .ds-card span { font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:#0D0D0D; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category filter chip — inverts to ink/lime when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#F4F4F4; color:#0D0D0D; border:1px solid rgb(13 13 13 / .09); border-radius:8px; padding:9px 14px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.08em; cursor:pointer; transition:all .3s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#A9D800; color:#667F00; } .ds-chip-on { background:#0D0D0D; color:#C6FF00; border-color:#0D0D0D; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(13 13 13 / .04), 0 8px 24px rgb(13 13 13 / .07); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C6FF00; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Paper field with hairline-strong border; lime ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; background:#FFFFFF; color:#0D0D0D; border:1px solid rgb(13 13 13 / .18); border-radius:8px; padding:12px 16px; font-family:Inter,sans-serif; font-size:14px; transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#5C5C5F; } .ds-input:focus { outline:0; border-color:#A9D800; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(198 255 0 / .3); }

components.name: Nav Link (Morphing Underline)
components.description: Nav link with a shared lime underline that slides between active states.
components.html: ShopFlash Sale
components.css: .ds-nav { position:relative; display:flex; gap:4px; } .ds-nav-link { position:relative; padding:9px 12px; border-radius:8px; color:#5C5C5F; font-family:Inter,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:color .3s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:#0D0D0D; } .ds-nav-on { color:#0D0D0D; } .ds-nav-bar { position:absolute; left:60px; bottom:-2px; width:44px; height:3px; border-radius:99px; background:#C6FF00; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgb(198 255 0 / .8); transform:translateX(0) scaleX(1); transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }

components.name: Seven-Segment Countdown Cell
components.description: Segmented countdown digit — ink segments on paper, lime on ink tiles.
components.css: .ds-seg-cell { position:relative; display:inline-block; width:32px; aspect-ratio:3/5; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid rgb(13 13 13 / .09); border-radius:8px; padding:3px; box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-seg { position:absolute; background:#E5E5E4; transition:background .1s; clip-path:polygon(12% 0, 88% 0, 100% 50%, 88% 100%, 12% 100%, 0 50%); } .ds-seg-on { background:#0D0D0D; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgb(13 13 13 / .35); }

components.name: Flash Sale Module (Glow-Low)
components.description: Ink urgency module with black/lime chevron band; glows as time runs low.
components.html:
UP TO 70% OFF

CLAIM A DEAL
components.css: .ds-flash { position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:#0D0D0D; color:#FFF; border-radius:16px; padding:28px; box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgb(13 13 13 / .06), 0 20px 44px rgb(13 13 13 / .14); animation:ds-glow 1.6s ease-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-glow { 0%,100% { box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgb(198 255 0 / .55), 0 20px 44px rgb(13 13 13 / .14); } 50% { box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgb(198 255 0 / 0), 0 20px 44px rgb(13 13 13 / .14); } } .ds-flash-band { position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:6px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #0D0D0D 0 10px, #C6FF00 10px 20px); } .ds-flash h3 { font-family:Unbounded,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:24px; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-flash h3 span { color:#C6FF00; } .ds-flash a { display:inline-flex; gap:8px; margin-top:16px; background:#C6FF00; color:#0D0D0D; padding:12px 20px; border-radius:8px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.15em; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .2s; } .ds-flash a:hover { background:#D7FF47; transform:scale(1.03); }

narrative.overview: ApnarDokan's storefront is a bright, animated bento board — the marketplace as a living bulletin where what's trending is literally bigger, what's urgent glows, and every tile is a door into the catalog. The ground is white paper; the layout is asymmetric modular tiles of varying size that reflow with FLIP, lift with a spring on hover, and reveal themselves in staggered rises as you scroll. One electric lime accent carries all the energy — nothing else is allowed to compete with it. The world refuses the uniform card-grid bazaar and the dark operator-wall console that preceded it; it borrows the grammar of retail signage and editorial boards: bold display headlines, mono readouts, hairline rules, and color committed at the tile level.
keyCharacteristics: White paper ground with bold ink type; one saturated accent (electric lime) at a time.
Bento tiles of varying size and color; 12–16px radii, never pills for panels.
Spring-physics hover (lift + scale 1.02 + shadow), FLIP reflow on filter, staggered rise reveals.
Mono readouts for prices, counts, and status labels; Unbounded display for headlines and the logo mark.
Role dashboards keep a separate dark console world via CSS-variable overrides.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only saturated color on the white storefront. Red, green, and blue appear only as semantic status, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Legible Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime text on white never falls below #667F00. Bright lime appears only as fill (with ink text) or on ink tiles.

rules.name: The Dual-Surface Rule
rules.body: The storefront is light; the role dashboards are dark. Shared components read surface, line, muted, and foreground from CSS variables that DashboardShell overrides.

rules.name: The Heading-Speaks Rule
rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow above a heading. The heading carries its own weight; section context rides below it as muted copy.

rules.name: The Spring Rule
rules.body: Hover lift is translateY(-6px) scale(1.02) over cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1). No other bounce or elastic easing anywhere; reveals use expo ease.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows at rest beyond the ambient card shadow; elevation is earned by interaction, never worn as decoration.

dos: Do commit color at the tile level — one black tile, one lime tile, white tiles — rather than scattering lime accents over the page.
Do size bento tiles by what they mean: the trending category is bigger; the hero thesis is 2×2.
Do use mono readouts (Plex Mono) for every price, count, and status label.
Do keep lime text on white at #667F00 or darker, and reserve bright lime for fills and ink tiles.
Do reuse the spring curve only for the brief's lift/pop moments and expo ease for reveals.
donts: Don't use a second saturated accent on the storefront — no orange, no purple, no teal.
Don't return to dark grounds or glowing phosphor effects on the storefront; darkness belongs to the role dashboards.
Don't put an eyebrow/kicker above a heading, or add section numbers that carry no information.
Don't animate width/left for the nav underline or progress bars — use transform.
Don't ship a uniform grid of identical cards where a bento board can say more about the data.
